scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,spec,scan -c cyan,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w @contrava/web" "npm run dev -w @contrava/api" "npm run dev -w @contrava/spec-worker" "npm run dev -w @contrava/scan-worker"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @contrava/shared && npm run build -w @contrava/api && npm run build -w @contrava/spec-worker && npm run build -w @contrava/scan-worker && npm run build -w @contrava/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @contrava/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
